description: This file defines an interface and a class for parsing command line strings into arguments, including internal logic for handling quotes, backslashes, and whitespace characters.

classes.name: CommandParser
classes.description: Implements ICommandParser to parse command line strings into argument lists, handling quotes, backslashes, and whitespace.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Internal helper class to manage parsing state, including current position, argument accumulation, and string building.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a command line string into a list of arguments by splitting on whitespace, respecting quotes and escape characters.

methods.name: SplitArgs
methods.description: Static method implementing the argument splitting logic based on command line parsing rules.

methods.name: ProcessQuote
methods.description: Handles parsing of quoted segments within the command line string.

methods.name: ProcessBackslash
methods.description: Handles escape sequences starting with backslash within the command line string.
